name: infisical-cli-action
description: GitHub Action to install the Infisical CLI
author: Jacob Hands

scripts.all: nub run format:check && nub run lint && nub run typecheck && nub run knip && nub run test && nub run bundle
scripts.bundle: esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node24 --format=esm --minify --legal-comments=none --keep-names --banner:js="import { createRequire as __createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = __createRequire(import.meta.url);" --outfile=dist/index.js && nub run license
